#### What this PR does / why we need it:

Every Kueue restart in the E2E suites pays for two controller-manager
pods plus leader election handover. My local runs showed the median
restart dropping from 24.9s with two replicas to 13.8s with one, and
the sequential suite from 638.8s to 535.8s.

From https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/12124#issuecomment-4683845695, two replicas stay as the default for HA-regression 
coverage; only the extended suites switch to one replica, since they 
are the longest and mostly exercise integrations rather than cache management.

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:
<!--
*Automatically closes linked issue when PR is merged.
Usage: `Fixes #<issue number>`, or `Fixes (paste link of issue)`.
_If PR is about `failing-tests or flakes`, please post the related issues/tests in a comment and do not use `Fixes`_*
-->

Contributes to #11606 ., Part of #12124

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

- The helm-based extended targets (`test-e2e-extended-helm`,
  `test-tas-e2e-extended-helm`, `test-e2e-sequential-extended-helm`)
  still deploy two replicas: the helm path uses
  `test/e2e/config/default/values.yaml` and bypasses
  `E2E_CONFIG_FOLDER`. Left out of scope here to keep the change
  small; happy to follow up if wanted.
- The multikueue extended target is untouched; it dispatches its own
  config via `hack/testing/e2e-multikueue-test.sh`.

## Walkthrough

This PR configures three e2e test runners to use an extended test configuration folder, and provides a Kustomization manifest that reduces controller-manager replicas to one, part of an effort to optimize CI job execution times.

## Changes

**Extended E2E Test Configuration**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Extended test runner environment setup** <br> `Makefile-test.mk`|Three e2e test runner recipes now export `E2E_CONFIG_FOLDER="extended"` to direct `./hack/testing/e2e-test.sh` to use the extended config.|
|**Extended kustomization with controller replica limit** <br> `test/e2e/config/extended/kustomization.yaml`|Adds a Kustomization manifest that includes the default test resources and overrides kueue-controller-manager to run with a single replica.|

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~3 minutes

## Possibly related issues

- kubernetes-sigs/kueue#12124: Both changes modify e2e Kustomize deployments to reduce controller-manager replicas, addressing cost optimization for faster test execution.

## Possibly related PRs

- [kubernetes-sigs/kueue#12069](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/12069): Modifies the same Makefile test runner wiring for sequential-extended targets.
- [kubernetes-sigs/kueue#12004](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/12004): Alters e2e harness invocation paths and environment variables for extended test suites.

### Comment by [@mimowo](https://github.com/mimowo) — 2026-06-12T10:55:40Z

@ikchifo I'm still open to discuss using 1 replica also for "baseline" tests. 

In the past we didn't have the HA Failover suite so using 2 replicas unconditionally was our idea for testing that scenarios. However currently I think using the dedicated test only might be a good idea - it would make a clear indication for where are the HA-related tests.

Could you maybe open another experimental PR to also enable single replica for the baseline tests so that we can assess how much we gain in terms of CI execution times?
